entities.name: Query Env gp160
observations: 768-aa sequence contains GP120 Pfam domain at residues 33–509 and GP41 Pfam domain at residues 528–718.
Sequence homology to reviewed HIV-1 gp160 proteins is 73.3–75.4% identity with approximately full query coverage and E-values of 0.
Architecture supports an N-terminal signal peptide, large cysteine-rich glycosylated ectodomain, gp120/gp41 precursor organization, one C-terminal transmembrane helix, and a cytoplasmic tail.
Likely functions as a trimeric viral class-I fusion envelope glycoprotein mediating receptor attachment and membrane fusion; exact strain/receptor usage is not established from sequence alone.
Sequence contains ambiguous X residues, so some physicochemical calculations were not performed.

entities.name: HIV-1 gp160
observations: Reviewed HIV-1 Env gp160 references describe proteolytic processing into gp120 and gp41, trimerization, CD4/coreceptor attachment, and class-I membrane fusion activity.
Reference proteins have an N-terminal signal peptide, extracellular gp120, gp41 fusion region, a single transmembrane helix, and a cytoplasmic tail.

entities.name: GP120 domain
observations: Pfam GP120 domain PF00516.25 detected at residues 33–509 with i-Evalue 4.8e-193.

entities.name: GP41 domain
